item.description:
Important

  • Requires Mac OS X 14.0 (Sonoma) or newer.

New Features

  • Math Evaluation in Fields: You can now type basic math equations directly into the value fields in the 'Advanced Conversion' window, and Peggy will automatically calculate the result for you.
  • Select All Shortcut: Added CMD+A support within the value fields of the 'Advanced Conversion' window for quicker editing and text selection.

Fixes & Improvements

  • AI/PDF Height Control: Fixed a bug that prevented the height control fields from functioning properly when processing Adobe Illustrator and PDF files.
  • PNG Transparency Preservation: Resolved a transparency bug that occurred when converting WEBP and AVIF files to PNG format.
